verdict.rationale: A tax agency with an online filing portal could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for filers or software integrators, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. Saving a draft return is a different feature, not isolation from production data. The probes found no API surface, and the transactional My DOR host sits behind an authenticated login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
